description: Rewrite all public and admin UI while preserving existing behavior and contracts, subject to owner-approved design and release gates.

tasks.title: Inventory current routes and behavior
tasks.description: Record all public and admin routes, visible actions, form fields, search and filter semantics, pagination, data sources, metadata, API calls, and current UI states. Capture the current build/check baseline and distinguish implemented behavior from mock or stub behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Every route and user-visible action in the rewrite scope is listed.
Data sources, API contracts, and mock or stub paths are identified.
Current build and existing checks are recorded without changing application code.

tasks.title: Resolve design and release decisions
tasks.description: Review the visual proposals at /design-preview and ask the owner to select or revise one. Obtain approval of a design brief or DESIGN.md covering visual identity, palette, typography, and theme behavior. Resolve production fallback-data policy, navigation destinations, and the trusted server-side authentication and authorization mechanism for admin. Document any backend work that requires separate approval.
acceptance_criteria: An owner-approved design direction exists before visual implementation.
Theme behavior and any supported modes are explicitly decided.
Mock-data behavior in production is decided and cannot masquerade as real data.
Admin server-side authorization is verified or admin production release is explicitly blocked.
Placeholder or missing navigation destinations are resolved.

tasks.title: Build approved shared UI foundation
tasks.description: Implement the approved design tokens, shared page structure, navigation, footer, form controls, dialogs, notifications, focus states, and responsive foundations. Preserve existing framework and deployment conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Shared components follow the approved design brief with reasons for major visual choices.
Navigation destinations exist and controls have real behavior.
Keyboard operation, visible focus, and accessible contrast are included.
Shared layout works at mobile and desktop breakpoints without horizontal overflow.

tasks.title: Rewrite directory and company details
tasks.description: Rewrite the public home and directory experience, search, industry and ownership filters, pagination, company cards, and company detail pages. Preserve routes, data shapes, and SEO behavior. Apply the approved fallback-data policy.
acceptance_criteria: Search, filters, pagination, company detail links, and career links work against the existing intended contracts.
Loading, empty, and error states explain the condition and an appropriate next action.
Mock content is removed from production or visibly labeled as demo content.
Company URLs, metadata, structured data, sitemap, and robots behavior are retained or approved changes are documented.

tasks.title: Rewrite public submission forms
tasks.description: Rewrite company submission and correction forms, preserving current fields and submission contract. Improve validation, pending, failure, success, and resubmission feedback without changing backend semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Both forms submit the expected fields and preserve existing route behavior.
Validation, loading, error, and success states are visible and usable.
Forms are keyboard-operable and responsive.

tasks.title: Rewrite admin login and dashboard
tasks.description: Rewrite the admin login and company dashboard, including search, status filters, create, edit, delete, validation, and submission review. Use verified existing contracts. Do not treat the localStorage marker as server-side authorization; production release is gated on an approved and verified auth mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: All existing dashboard workflows work and report operation failures clearly.
Admin UI behavior matches the verified backend contracts.
Production release remains blocked until server-side authorization is verified.
No success-shaped UI is shown for mock or stub operations.

tasks.title: Rewrite career discovery admin
tasks.description: Rewrite domain submission, batch scan, results, history, and recheck actions for the career discovery screen. Preserve verified API contracts and show loading, error, empty, and result states.
acceptance_criteria: Single and batch discovery flows handle success and failure visibly.
History and result destinations are real and keyboard accessible.
The interface clearly reports limits and does not imply an operation succeeded when the API failed.

tasks.title: Verify rewrite and staged release
tasks.description: Run build and available checks, exercise every interactive element, validate responsive layouts, keyboard use, contrast, UI states, supported themes, SEO, and OpenNext/Cloudflare compatibility. Record per-control click-through evidence and unresolved release gates.
acceptance_criteria: Production build and available project checks pass.
Every link and interactive control has recorded evidence of its actual behavior.
Mobile, keyboard, contrast, state, and supported-theme checks pass.
SEO and OpenNext/Cloudflare behavior are verified.
Admin release gate and all remaining risks are explicitly reported.
